description: (0.5.0) Exactly one entry per reliance-changing change and none otherwise; evidence verbatim (RFC-ACDP-0018 §3, §4). Behavioral, registry-side.

input.setup: Fresh registry; record the feed head before each step.

expected.behavior: POST /contexts/X/retract appends one lifecycle entry: event byte-identical to registry_state.lifecycle_events[i], event_receipt byte-identical to registry_state.event_receipts[i], recorded_at = event_receipt.accepted_at.
POST /contexts/X/republish appends one lifecycle entry (event_type republished).
Publishing Y2 with supersedes = Y1 appends one superseded entry with ctx_id Y1, superseded_by Y2, registry_receipt = Y2's receipt, recorded_at = its created_at, lineage_id = Y1's lineage.
Accepting a key-revocation context R appends one key_revocation entry with ctx_id R, registry_receipt = R's receipt, agent_id = metadata.revoked_key_controller when present else R.agent_id.
Publishing a body with no supersedes and type other than key-revocation appends nothing.
A byte-identical retry of the retraction (HTTP 200, no new receipt) appends nothing.
